title: Autonomous Line Tracking Rover
tagline: Deploy autonomous warehouse logistics! Guide an AGV robot over complex black electrical tape race tracks.

phases.instructions: Locate from your kit: Arduino Uno, TCRT5000 Dual Line Trackers (comp_14), 130 DC Motor (comp_33), L293D Motor Driver IC, Crash Switch (comp_04), Battery clip, Breadboard, and wires.
verificationCheckpoints: Two TCRT5000 IR reflectance sensors ready
L293D H-bridge IC notch orientation identified

phases.instructions: Mount L293D across center breadboard trough. Connect motor controls to Pins 5, 6, 9, 10. Connect Left Line Sensor to Pin 2, Right Line Sensor to Pin 3, and Crash Switch to Pin 4.
verificationCheckpoints: L293D pin 16 (VCC1) to 5V, pin 8 (VCC2) to battery power
Common ground linked between battery and Arduino

phases.instructions: Adjust the tiny trimmer potentiometers on the TCRT5000 boards so the indicator LED turns ON over white paper and OFF over black tape.
verificationCheckpoints: Sensors differentiate black tape from white floor at 5mm distance
Crash switch triggers cleanly upon bumper contact

phases.instructions: Review differential robot steering: both sensors on white = drive forward; left sensor on black line = pivot left; right on black line = pivot right; crash switch active = full emergency stop!
phases.codeExplanation:
- Digital inputs 2 and 3 evaluate optical infrared reflectance in real time.
- Dual H-Bridge channels control wheel motor velocity independently to correct heading.
- Bumper collision switch immediately halts motors to prevent damage.

phases.instructions: Place rover on a black tape loop track. Power on battery switch: the rover tracks the line smoothly around corners and stops when bumping a wall!
verificationCheckpoints: Rover follows closed-loop tape path without leaving line
Collision bumper immediately cuts motor drive

phases.instructions: Autonomous Vehicle Engineer! You deployed differential robotics navigation and real-time obstacle avoidance.
verificationCheckpoints: Ready to claim Rover Commander badge

variants.title: 3-Sensor PID Tracking
variants.description: Add a third TCRT5000 sensor in center to implement proportional steering corrections.
variants.wiringDifferences: Add Center IR sensor to Pin A0
variants.codeAdaptation: Compute error offset (-1, 0, 1) and calculate proportional PWM differential steering

extensionMissions.title: Autonomous Obstacle Braking
extensionMissions.objective: Mount an ultrasonic sensor (comp_01) on the front bumper to stop rover 15cm before collisions.
hints: If distance < 15, immediately brake motors and sound warning beep

story: The Monster Lab logistics rover needs to deliver supplies around the facility without human drivers! Program dual TCRT5000 infrared reflection sensors and an L293D dual motor driver to follow floor lines autonomously.

troubleshooting.symptom: Rover spins in circles instead of following line
troubleshooting.cause: Motor wiring polarity reversed on one channel
troubleshooting.solution: Swap motor terminals on L293D pins 3 and 6 (or 11 and 14).
diagnosticSteps: Verify both wheels spin forward during driveForward()
